persons.identity_hint: Encrypted in the browser with the company key: the server cannot read them. Leave empty to skip.

exports.regional_intro: Veneto Region A01 layout (Regional Law 21/2008, art. 49 par. 4): one row per rescued person, no identifying data. The preview shows exclusions and duplicates before the file is generated.
exports.area_not_loaded: ISTAT boundaries not loaded: the territorial filter is unavailable (load_istat_boundaries command).
exports.exclude_buildings: Exclude events that happened in buildings
exports.warning_slope_missing_regional_code: {{count}} slopes without a regional code: rows will carry the name only.
exports.warning_events_without_geometry: {{count}} events without a position: the administrative area cannot be checked (they are included).
exports.warning_administrative_boundaries_not_lo: Administrative boundaries not loaded: no territorial filter applied.
exports.dataset_intro: CSV or XLSX of events or persons with the active global filters. No identifying data: initials and age classes only.
exports.local_filters_note: Table-local filters (cause, slope, diagnosis…) are not applied.

admin.name: Name
admin.invite_sent: Invite sent to {{email}}: they will receive an email to set their password.
admin.disable_confirm: Disable {{email}}? Active sessions are closed and access is blocked.
admin.permissions_hint: (roles give the base permissions; here single permissions are granted or denied)
admin.teams_intro: Teams (rescue bodies) group users and events. A team with recorded events cannot be deactivated.
admin.team_has_events: Has recorded events: cannot be deactivated
admin.devices_intro: The mobile app enrolls by scanning a QR code generated here; pending devices must be authorized (unless configured otherwise).
admin.revoke_confirm: Revoke device {{name}}? It will no longer be able to send data.
admin.enrollment_hint: Scan the QR with the SAFE app within {{minutes}} minutes. The code is single-use.
admin.territory_intro: Ski areas, zones and slopes (with the regional code for the A01 layout) and lifts. Geometries are loaded as GeoJSON (WGS84).
admin.geojson_hint: Leave empty to keep the current geometry.
admin.lookups_intro: Standard vocabularies apply to all companies: here single entries can be disabled or custom entries added with labels in three languages.
admin.settings_intro: Company settings: general data, event validity and locking rules, device authorization, duplicate rule.
admin.validity_hint: When validity rules change, the validity of all events is recomputed in the background.

keys.create_intro: Create your personal key: it lets you read identifying data (if authorised) and hold the company key. The passphrase never leaves the browser.
keys.passphrase_hint: At least 12 characters. If you forget it you can regenerate the key, but you will need to be authorised again.
keys.unlock_intro: Enter the passphrase of your personal key. It stays in memory for 15 minutes of inactivity.
keys.reset_intro: Regenerating the key drops your current authorisations: a custodian will have to grant them again. No data is lost.
keys.grant_yes: You are authorised to read identifying data.
keys.grant_no: You are not authorised to read identifying data.
keys.intro: The company key encrypts the identifying data of rescued persons. The server only stores public keys and encrypted private keys: who can read the data is decided here, by authorising custodians.
keys.not_initialized: The company key has not been created yet. Unlock your personal key and initialise it: you will get a 24-word recovery code to keep offline.
keys.init_done: Key created: keep the recovery code
keys.rotate_confirm: Create a new key version? Data will be re-sealed in the browser; other custodians will need a new authorisation.
keys.rotate_done: Key rotated: keep the new recovery code
keys.recover_intro: Enter the 24 words of the recovery code. The browser decrypts the company key, authorises you and generates a new code (the previous one becomes invalid).
keys.recover_done: Recovery succeeded: keep the new code
keys.recovery_invalid: The code must contain 24 valid words.
keys.self_ok: Your session can decrypt with the active key.
keys.self_no_grant: You have no usable authorisation on the active key: ask a custodian or use recovery.
keys.self_locked: Unlock your personal key to operate on the company key.
keys.need_grant_self: Your (unlocked) authorisation on the active key is required for this operation.
keys.grant_hint: Only active users who already created their key are listed.
keys.words_warning: Write down these 24 words and keep them offline (safe, DPO). They are shown only once: without them, if every custodian loses the key, identifying data cannot be recovered.
keys.words_confirm: I have written down and stored the recovery code
keys.copied: Code copied to the clipboard: paste it somewhere safe and clear the clipboard.

audit.intro: Every access to identifying data, change, unlock, export and key operation is recorded permanently. The log never contains personal data values.

retention.title: Retention and anonymisation
retention.intro: After the retention period from the event date, identifying data, initials and age are removed (the age class is kept). Automatic anonymisation runs nightly; the audit log is purged after its own period.
